items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: Philly Miller was his name. ... His father was a one-man band runner.

ctx.x: Who was in Classy's band, by the way?

Oh, he had a fine old bass player. Strictly a faker, as I remember it, but boy, he could play. Philly Miller was his name. Philly? Miller. His father was a one-man band runner. He used to be on Canal Street. Oh, yeah. He used to go around and had a little outfit of drums and a kazoo, a banjo. And he played everything imaginable, you know, with his hands and feet, all at one time.
I saw him down by the ferry, that's a guy.
